versions.changelog:
Initial release of sol-devto-viral: a three-in-one growth engine for dev.to.

- Mines and logs 50 trending AI articles from dev.to.
- Generates contextual comment copy to advertise Sol's posts on relevant articles (comment content is logged, not posted).
- Cross-posts new Jekyll blog posts to dev.to with audience adaptation.
- Runs daily at 10am UK time.
- Maintains logs for trends, advertisements, and cross-posts for easy tracking.
